reason: I’ll start assembling the solar furnace; the steel looks useful as a frame for the reflector petals.
expectation: I expect a supported reflector assembly, though it may still need the receiver.

alternatives.reason: A framed screen could prepare the regolith, but I’ll start with the furnace.

effect: The reflector is supported, so I can add the receiver.
reaction: The result was straightforward and matched my expectation.
reason: The receiver should complete the furnace assembly.
expectation: I expect a working solar furnace, although it may need another step.

alternatives.reason: The screen could prepare feedstock, but I want to finish the furnace first.

effect: The furnace is complete, leaving the formed feedstock goal.
reaction: The focused sunlight heating the receiver is a satisfying, physically clear result.
reason: The only offered combination should make a screen for preparing the regolith.
expectation: I expect a supported screen that can separate finer material, though further processing will likely be needed.

effect: The sieve is ready to process the excavated regolith.
reaction: The result was straightforward and expected.
reason: The only offered combination should separate the regolith for feedstock.
expectation: I expect screened regolith, which may still need pressing into a form.

effect: Screening produced an even feedstock ready for the press.
reaction: The separation of coarse stones makes the preparation clear and sensible.
reason: The only offered action should form the screened material for the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the press to compact the regolith into a formed piece, though it may need further processing.

effect: The press completed the feedstock goal, but the blanks still need firing for strength.
reaction: The distinction between shaping and strengthening the material was useful and physically clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Assembling the solar furnace was most worthwhile: the focused sunlight heating the receiver made its purpose tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the sieve was the least engaging moment; it was straightforward preparation with little added detail.

surprise.text: The pressed blanks remain weak and must stay supported until firing bonds their grains.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The screening and pressing sequence had a clear purpose, though the later choices were the only offered actions.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the blanks are fired and used; the chapter made that next stage intriguing.
